title: Keep RepoPact on the personal GitHub repository

preflight.note: Recorded before implementation to direct current RepoPact identity references to its personal GitHub repository while preserving historical records and the separate Proving Ground repository.

acceptance_criteria.text: The local origin fetch and push URLs directly name JeremyShows/repopact.
Current RepoPact and RepoPact Proving Ground links point directly to their current personal repositories.
Historical records remain unchanged, and the active work item is closed with linked validation evidence.

notes: Initially completed after correcting RepoPact's personal owner references. Reopened on 2026-09-23 after a direct GitHub API audit verified that the linked RepoPact Proving Ground repository is also owned by JeremyShows, not ForgeWireLabs. The original evidence run is retained as the earlier snapshot; the follow-up records direct owner verification and current pointer updates. Repository validation reports the unrelated research freshness expiry dated 2026-09-18.
